items.title: 14.5 Fiza par insani sargarmiyon ka asar (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 14.5, printed page 311.

blocks.text: Insani sargarmiyan fiza par khasa asar dalti hain, bunyadi taur par fossil fuels jalane aur jangal katne (deforestation) se; yeh climate change, hawa ki aaloodgi, kharab hawa ke mayar aur doosre maholiyati masail mein hissa dalti hain. Shehri ilaqon mein zyada tar hawa ki aaloodgi insani zaraye se aati hai, mutaharrik (cars, trucks, hawai jahaz, bahri engines) ya point zaraye (factories, bijli ghar).

blocks.prompt: Chaar insani sargarmiyan bayan karein jo hawa ka mayar bigarti hain, har ek ke liye ek pollutant batate hue (exercise Q.2d).
blocks.explanation: Gariyon mein fossil fuels jalana CO, NOx aur VOCs chhorta hai; bijli gharon aur bhattiyon mein coal jalana SO2 aur particulate matter; jangal katna aur fasal ki baqiyat jalana CO2 aur dhuen ke zarraat; sanat, dhaat-sazi aur koore ka jalana lead aur mercury jaisi bhari dhatein.

items: Insani asar zyada tar fossil fuel jalane aur jangal katne se; shehri aaloodgi mutaharrik aur point zaraye se.
